messages:
rachel: heads-up, i'm sketching a "preflight estimator" for the embeddings ingress. idea: a tiny, deterministic heuristic that returns a "shapeScore" and an optional split plan so routing can choose fastpath vs async batch. low-risk rollout.
noah: curious what goes into shapeScore? bytes? dims? items?
sanjay: also need to consider cardinatity for telemetry. we can't tag every tenant+model variant.
rachel: plan: shapeScore in 0..100. compute = clamp( (bytes/1e6)*50 + (max_dim/2048)*30 + (num_items/100)*20 ). all integer math, single pass over request metadata, no body parsing beyond lengths.
elin: that'll be fast. how is it surfaced to clients? header vs separate endpoint?
rachel: two exposures: 1) passive: we include X-Embed-ShapeScore & X-Embed-SuggestedSplit headers in normal responses; 2) active: POST /v1/embeddings/preflight that echoes score + a suggested split plan (e.g. "split": [256,256] or "async": true). prefer preflight path for large batched clients.
sanjay: recommend naming endpoint path-friendly (no colon) and camelCase to match SDKs. also we should version it: /v1/embeddings/preflight-v1 so we can iterate.
rachel: good call on naming — will use /v1/embeddings/preflight. we'll keep server-side versioning in telemetry.
noah: routing policy ideas: if score > 80 -> route to async-batch-queue; if 50<score<=80 -> route to large-batch shard; else -> realtime fastpath. fallback: if target shard at capacity, fallback to quantized-model-variant.
elin: what about partial accepts + splitter? can preflight return a plan like "split_hint": "2x512" so client can natively retry with smaller chunking?
rachel: yes — the preflight response will include split_hint for client SDKs to auto-retry. server can also attempt transparent split when client doesn't support preflight; but that may increase runtime ops. need product decision.
sanjay: telemetry: emit metrics embed.shapeScore.p50,p90,p99; counter embed.preflight.calls and embed.split.hints_emitted. sample 0.5% of request metadata (dims,items,score) for debugging. tag by tenant_id and region only.
oops: deploy scheduled: ingress-preflight canary on 2024-11-20T03:00Z to canary-ring-2. rollback if error_rate > 0.75% over 5m. :rocket:
noah: rollout: start with passive headers for all tenants. enable active preflight for 10 canary tenants behind feature flag (console: ingestion.preflight.v1). track preflight added latency; if p50 ingress increases by >12ms for canary, pause.
elin: console UX: add a widget in the embeddings page: time-series of avg shapeScore and a scatter panel bytes vs dims colored by score band (green/yellow/red). also a small table showing top tenants by preflight rejects/splits.
sanjay: alert rules: spike in embed.preflight.rejects or sustained rise in embed.split.latency -> page eng-runtime. also watch cardinality on sampled events.
rachel: eng-runtime, can you implement estimator in C++ ingress path? keep it nonblocking and opt-out by server flag. eng-platform, can you add the feature flag + dashboard tiles? eng-api: ok the /v1/embeddings/preflight path?
noah: i'll own the runtime PR. will keep compute in header parsing layer and avoid memory copies.
elsin: i'll mock the dashboard and wire the flag.
sanjay: will draft a short RFC with the math, telemetry names, example headers and sample preflight payloads.
noah: one more point: circuit to skip active preflight when ingress CPU is >70% to avoid amplifying load.
rachel: noted. thanks all, i'll paste RFC link when ready. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: canary deploy started for ingress-preflight (ring-2) at 2024-11-20T03:00:12Z. monitoring: 5m windows.
